policy_title: Total Knee Arthroplasty (L36575)
note: Noridian consolidated its TKA LCDs eff 11/06/2025: L36577 retired; L36575 'Total Knee Arthroplasty' now covers all JE+JF states and is currently in effect (verified in CMS MCD).

2026-08-21 sweep: Checked every Medicare Administrative Contractor. No NCD and no active LCD states medical-necessity criteria for this procedure. Every MAC arthroplasty LCD expressly excludes unicompartmental knee replacement from its criteria (e.g. Noridian L36575, Palmetto L33456, CGS L40232, WPS L39911, NGS L36039, First Coast L33618); Novitas has no arthroplasty LCD at all. Coverage is decided under general section 1862(a)(1)(A) reasonable-and-necessary review, which means the denial letter must state its own reasoning and the surgeon's documentation carries the case.
